commit_message: Add ADR 0126 Timeline foundation on refreshed main
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
## ADR 0126 implementation

This Draft PR is rebuilt from current `main` after ADR 0132 and ADR 0123 landed. It integrates the validated Timeline foundation from #90 without merging or force-applying the stale #90 branch. Follow-up Dispatcher requests on this same refreshed branch complete the ADR 0126 Definition of Done.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged until runtime composition, Timeline Player / Project Rust control, shared Editor/CLI/MCP authoring parity, Sequencer, persistent Scene View preview, packaged Player, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are complete.
